name: Vanilla Chip Fruit Tart (Crust)
author: Annita Layton
instructions: Heat oven to 300°. In small mixer bowl, beat butter and powdered sugar until smooth; blend in flour. Press mixture onto bottom and up side of 12 inch round pizza pan. Flute edge, if desired. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned; cool completely.
